_about: Listen mode rules for Contain the Sharp. Everything content-specific about WHICH audio plays and WHAT happens after lives here or in the audio manifest, never in js/layered-sharps.js. Trigger rules read the pre-check answers as they were when the learner chose Listen mode (frozen there). Rule kinds: "correct" (that pre-check question answered right, and confidently if confidence is ever captured) and "scoreAtMost" (an agreement score at or below `value`, on the 1-5 scale).

checks._about: The question asked after the listen for each topic, as the deck screen whose question it is, per the version of the topic that played (missing versions fall back to normal). role: knowledge questions can trigger the review set; belief items cannot (yet).

review._about: A missed knowledge check gets that topic's fact cards, then ONE retry of the same question. After a pass, or a second miss, the learner moves on and the retry is recorded under retryKey. Belief misses (f1, f3) get no review yet — see the hook in js/layered-sharps.js (LISTEN_FEEL_HOOK).
